facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple strike, the watch check, Félix's watch at twenty minutes to nine, and Aurèle scolding him.
Madame looked at the salon clock when the temple struck ten and it showed five minutes to ten.

Piquet was played without a break, the doctor left the room to fetch cigars, and he went out at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock. The 'until he went out' link is carried by 'We played without a break' followed by 'And then the doctor left the room.'
As he went out he asked her to play; she sat at the piano at once, played until he came back, and stopped when he came in.
'A moment after he came back the hall clock struck eleven.'
